{"revisions":[{"revision_id":"R001","verdict":"FINDING","observation":"机制方向错误：英文只说守护者“变强”，源码实际是移动速度提升（movement_speed + 0.5），中文却具体写成“伤害增加了”，指向了错误的属性。","evidence":"source: \"You feel the guardian of this place grow in power.\"; target: \"你感受到这个地方的守护者的伤害增加了。\"; fixed_context: \"m.movement_speed = m.movement_speed + 0.5. English grow in power; code is movement speed.\""},{"revision_id":"R002","verdict":"OK","observation":"OK：英文显示串误写为 void shards，实际代码恢复的是 Void Stars 层数，中文“虚空之星”忠于实际机制，且与技能说明用词一致。","evidence":"fixed_context: \"Void Stars=虚空之星 ... Core ToME Void Shards is a different summon (虚空碎片) ... English says void shards; code restores Void Stars stacks.\"; target: \"恢复%d个虚空之星\""},{"revision_id":"R003","verdict":"OK","observation":"OK：使用条件的合取/析取结构与英文及 on_pre_use 一致（格式塔必须激活，且护盾存在或强化格式塔不在冷却）。","evidence":"source: \"requires Gestalt to be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown\"; target: \"需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中\""},{"revision_id":"R004","verdict":"OK","observation":"OK：该提示对应第一次选取（存为 target/source 一方），译名与技能说明的“源生物”一致，与“选择受害者”提示区分清楚。","evidence":"fixed_context: \"first logPlayer Select the source: then getTarget stored as target ... talent info uses 源生物 和 牺牲生物\"; target: \"选择源生物:\""},{"revision_id":"R005","verdict":"FINDING","observation":"资源/状态身份错误：提示是缺少“异变之手”（getTentacleCombat 为 nil），中文却写成需要“空闲的副手”，与另一条独立的副手空手提示混淆。","evidence":"source: \"You require a mutated hand!\"; target: \"你需要空闲的副手！\"; fixed_context: \"Mutated Hand=异变之手; separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手 ... Constrict logs You require a mutated hand! when getTentacleCombat is nil.\""},{"revision_id":"R006","verdict":"OK","observation":"OK：是射手故意打偏而非目标闪避，中文“故意打偏了”与技能说明一致；两个占位符（射手名 / his_her）绑定关系保持。","evidence":"fixed_context: \"First %s=shooter name or Something; second=his/her. Deliberate miss, not dodge.\"; target: \"%s故意打偏了%s的射击。\""},{"revision_id":"R007","verdter":"OK","verdict":"OK","observation":"OK：两个条件（机械蜘蛛相邻、自身处于非战斗）与 on_pre_use 的拒绝条件一致。","evidence":"source: \"You require your mecharachnid to be adjacent, and must be out of combat.\"; fixed_context: \"rejects if self.in_combat or mecharachnid.in_combat or not adjacent/missing\""},{"revision_id":"R008","verdict":"UNCERTAIN","observation":"感知效果持续时间存疑：中文沿用英文的“3 回合”，但代码 setEffect(EFF_SENSE, 4, ...) 为 4 回合；无法判定应忠于代码还是保持与英文显示串一致。","evidence":"source: \"see all enemies within %d spaces for the next 3 turns\"; target: \"在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物\"; fixed_context: \"setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, {range=rad, actor=1}). English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns.\""}]}

I reviewed all 8 items read-only and am returning the structured verdicts now.

revisions.observation: 机制方向错误：英文只说守护者“变强”，源码实际提升的是移动速度（movement_speed + 0.5），中文写成“伤害增加了”，指向错误属性。
revisions.evidence: source: "You feel the guardian of this place grow in power."; target: "你感受到这个地方的守护者的伤害增加了。"; fixed_context: "m.movement_speed = m.movement_speed + 0.5. English grow in power; code is movement speed."

revisions.observation: OK：英文显示串误写为 void shards，实际代码恢复的是 Void Stars 层数，中文“虚空之星”忠于实际机制且与技能说明一致。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "Void Stars=虚空之星 ... Core ToME Void Shards is a different summon (虚空碎片) ... English says void shards; code restores Void Stars stacks."; target: "恢复%d个虚空之星"

revisions.observation: OK：使用条件的合取/析取结构与英文及 on_pre_use 分组一致（格式塔必须激活，且护盾存在或强化格式塔不在冷却）。
revisions.evidence: source: "requires Gestalt to be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown"; target: "需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中"

revisions.observation: OK：该提示对应第一次选取（存为 target，即链接源），译名与技能说明的“源生物”一致，与“选择受害者”区分清楚。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "first logPlayer Select the source: then getTarget stored as target ... talent info uses 源生物 and 牺牲生物"; target: "选择源生物:"

revisions.observation: 资源/状态身份错误：该提示是缺少被动天赋“异变之手”（getTentacleCombat 为 nil），中文却写成需要“空闲的副手”，与另一条独立的副手空手提示混淆。
revisions.evidence: source: "You require a mutated hand!"; target: "你需要空闲的副手！"; fixed_context: "Mutated Hand=异变之手; separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手 ... Constrict logs You require a mutated hand! when getTentacleCombat is nil."

revisions.observation: OK：机制为射手故意打偏而非目标闪避，中文与技能说明一致；两个占位符（射手名 / his_her）绑定关系保持。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "First %s=shooter name or Something; second=his/her. Deliberate miss, not dodge."; target: "%s故意打偏了%s的射击。"

revisions.observation: OK：两个条件（机械蜘蛛相邻、自身处于非战斗状态）与 on_pre_use 的拒绝条件一致。
revisions.evidence: source: "You require your mecharachnid to be adjacent, and must be out of combat."; fixed_context: "rejects if self.in_combat or mecharachnid.in_combat or not adjacent/missing, then this shared logPlayer"

revisions.observation: 感知持续时间存疑：中文沿用英文“3 回合”，但代码 setEffect(EFF_SENSE, 4, ...) 为 4 回合；证据不足以判定应忠于代码还是保持与英文显示串一致。
revisions.evidence: source: "see all enemies within %d spaces for the next 3 turns"; target: "让你能够在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物"; fixed_context: "setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, {range=rad, actor=1}). English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns."
